CountUp 和 Sparkline 也可以单独使用：数值变化时滚动过去，趋势: CountUp and Sparkline also work on their own: the number rolls to each new value, and the line takes the accent color.
ECharts 配置；颜色从 useChartColors / chartBas: The ECharts option; take colors from useChartColors / chartBase so they follow the accent and dark mode
Panel 是页面里每个区块的容器：标题、说明、右侧操作；表格和列表设 padd: Panel holds every section of a page: title, description and actions on the right; tables and lists use padded={false} to sit flush.
loading 时数字显示骨架而不是 0；onClick 让卡片可点击，用 cl: While loading the number is a skeleton, not 0; onClick makes a card clickable, and className marks the selected one.
option 标注为 EChartsOption；chartBase 提供坐标轴: Type option as EChartsOption; chartBase styles the axes, grid and tooltip, brandLine / brandArea are the theme gradients. Legend and series names go through t().
不传标题时只是一张带内边距的卡片。: Without a title it's just a padded card.
仪表盘和详情页的展示件：指标卡（滚动数字、迷你趋势线）、ECharts 图表、卡: Display pieces for dashboards and detail pages: stat cards (rolling numbers, mini trend lines), ECharts charts, card containers, page headers and user avatars. Chart colors come from useChartColors and follow accent and dark-mode changes. Chart only includes the chart types registered in lib/echarts (line, bar, pie, funnel, heatmap, sankey); register any other type there first.
内容区内边距；表格、列表这类贴边内容设为 false: Padding around the body; false for flush content such as tables and lists
初始化参数，如渲染器: Init options, such as the renderer
变化标记的颜色：好消息、坏消息或持平: Color of the change badge: good news, bad news or flat
只写数据相关的事实，不写功能介绍（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Facts about the data only, not a feature intro (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
只设高度，宽度跟随容器: Set only the height; the width follows the container
右上角的变化标记，如 +12%: Change badge in the top right, e.g. +12%
右侧的按钮，窄屏时换到标题下方: Buttons on the right; below the title on narrow screens
图标、单位、小数位和变化标记；有趋势数据时传 trend 画迷你趋势线，没有时用: Icon, unit, decimals and a change badge; pass trend for a mini trend line when the data has one, otherwise explain the number in hint.
外层的 class；不要用 mb-* 改下方间距: Class of the wrapper; don't change the gap below with mb-*
头像地址；为空或加载失败时显示首字母: Image URL; empty or failing to load shows the first letter
底部一行说明，没有趋势时用它解释数字: A line of text at the bottom; explains the number when there is no trend
延迟到下一帧更新: Defers the update to the next frame
指标名称（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Metric name (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
按事件名绑定 ECharts 事件，如 click: ECharts event handlers by event name, e.g. click
数值，变化时滚动到新值；不是数字时显示 0: The number; rolls to each new value; shows 0 when it isn't numeric
数字后的单位，如 人、%（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Unit after the number, e.g. 人 or % (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
数字和变化标记显示骨架，不要用 0 占位: Skeletons for the number and the badge; never use 0 as a placeholder
数据点；大于 0 的点少于 2 个时不绘制: Data points; nothing is drawn with fewer than 2 points above 0
新配置整体替换旧配置，而不是合并（数据条数会变时用）: Replace the old option instead of merging into it (use when the number of items changes)
显示名：图片的 alt，也是首字母的来源；为空时显示 ?: Display name: the image's alt text and the source of the letter; ? when empty
有图片时显示图片，没有或加载失败时显示名字首字母；尺寸用 className。: Shows the image when there is one, otherwise (or if it fails to load) the first letter of the name; size it with className.
标签前的图标（lucide 图标组件）: Icon before the label (a lucide icon component)
标题下方的内容，如状态标签: Content under the title, such as status badges
标题下的说明，只写有信息量的内容（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Description under the title; only when it carries information (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
标题右侧的按钮: Buttons to the right of the title
标题（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Title (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
每个页面顶部一个：右侧放操作按钮，description 只写数据相关的事实，c: One at the top of every page: action buttons on the right, description only for facts about the data, children under the title.
点击卡片；传了之后显示手型光标: Card click; when set, the card shows a pointer cursor
目标数值；不是数字时滚动到 0: Target number; rolls to 0 when it isn't numeric
迷你趋势线的数据；只在数据确实有趋势时传: Data for the mini trend line; only when the data really has a trend
通过 getEchartsInstance() 拿到 ECharts 实例: Reach the ECharts instance through getEchartsInstance()
页面标题（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Page title (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
饼图只取 chartBase 的颜色、字体和提示框；onEvents 绑定点击事: A pie chart takes only the colors, font and tooltip from chartBase; onEvents binds the click event.
首字母的 class，放大头像时一起调字号: Class of the letter; scale its font size with the avatar
默认有内边距，内容直接放进去。: Padded by default: put the content straight in.
